text:
marta: kicking off Thalia7B int4 bring-up. quick smoke shows low logprobs and repetition on summarization tests. logs attached — guessing something with token mapping. :confused:

jia: can you paste the eval summary + quant profile used?

marta: ran `onboard.sh thalia7b --quant int4-symmetric --per-channel --batch 8` then `pytest tests/evals_summaries.py::test_smoke_thalia`

snip logs:
```
LOADING Thalia7B
APPLY QUANT PROFILE: int4-symmetric per-channel
TOKENIZER: normalized emoji clusters -> single token (ZWJ collapsed)
EVAL: ROUGE-L 0.45 (baseline fp16 0.60)
EVAL: avg_logprob -2.05 (baseline -1.30)
SAMPLE: repeating tokens: "the the" observed
```

ryan: emoji/zwj collapsing can change token ids ordering. if our rotary sin/cos indexing relies on a specific token-id->rotary-index mapping that would corrupt phase alignment. did the conversion reorder indices?

sam: also check kvcache mapping. remapped ids + int4 quant noise could amplify mis-attention. quick sanity: compare index map lengths and some examples.

marta: diff between upstream vocab and converted shows ~18 emojis moved and a few zero-width joiners merged. fp16 run is fine, int4 bad. linked minimal repro: https://internal/gists/thalia-int4-smoke

jia: try forcing tokenizer aliasing (keep old ids for special clusters) and set rotary_scale=1.0 (we had auto-scale 0.78). see if that stabilizes.

marta: running config:
```
model:
  quant: int4-symmetric
  tokenizer: force_alias=true
  rotary_scale: 1.0
  kvcache: enabled
```

(eval-bot): smoke eval completed: ROUGE-L 0.54, avg_logprob -1.44, repetition dropped to 0.02. :white_check_mark:

sam: that suggests rotary/phase sensitivity to token-id permutation. when converter shuffled emoji indices, the assumed rotary index mapping was wrong. int4 quant makes it worse.

ryan: remediation paths: (1) make conversion preserve token ids for special sequences (emoji/ZWJ), (2) make runtime compute rotary base on embedding slot rather than token id, or (3) ensure tokenizer aliasing as temporary band-aid. Option 2 is safest long-term but needs perf review.

marta: created INF-2319: "Thalia7B onboarding: emoji index shift -> rotary misalign in int4" assigned to eng-ml + eng-infra. immediate fix: pin alias ranges in converter and re-run night batch. added `tokenizer_aliasing: true` to model manifest.

jia: add regression eval comparing int4 vs fp16 on full QA+Summ set, upload per-example diffs to s3://rdw-onboard/thalia7b/int4-diffs/. please add to onboarding checklist.

ryan: i pushed `eng-ml/tests/rotary_index_permutation_check.py` — simulates token-id permutation + rotary sanity asserts. add to conversion CI.

sam: update onboarding playbook note: when vocab has many emoji/ZWJ combos, run `rotary_index_permutation_check` and `kvcache_map_sanity` as blockers before promoting quant artifacts. :memo:

marta: final smoke with pinned aliases + rotary_scale=1.0: ROUGE-L 0.56, avg_logprob -1.38. running full overnight eval and will post results. thanks all :rocket:
